title: The Broken Seal
summary: Compare a clerk's account with physical traces left on a resealed archive packet.

scenes.title: Municipal Archive Office
scenes.description: A closed records office containing a resealed packet, discarded ticket, loose thread, and clerk Mara Vale.

characters.name: Mara Vale
characters.description: The clerk responsible for closing and sealing the archive.

items.name: Blue wax smear
items.description: A flaked patch of blue sealing wax on the packet edge.
items.inspectText: Two wax layers overlap. The lower layer is broken; a warmer blue layer was pressed over it later.

items.name: Ticket stub
items.description: A tram ticket from the evening route.
items.inspectText: The ticket was punched at 20:42. It narrows a timeline but does not prove who opened the archive.

items.name: Muddy thread
items.description: A dark thread carrying dried mud.
items.inspectText: The thread resembles a coat fiber from the public corridor. It is plausible contamination, not proof of resealing.

clues.title: Overlapping blue wax
clues.content: The packet's original seal was broken and covered by a second application of blue wax.
clues.inventoryDescription: Two layers show that the packet was opened and resealed.
clues.narrativeMeaning: This directly contradicts a claim that the seal remained intact.

clues.title: 20:42 ticket stub
clues.content: A ticket places an unknown traveler on the evening tram route.
clues.inventoryDescription: A plausible timeline clue without a direct link to the seal.
clues.narrativeMeaning: It can support speculation but cannot crack the statement.

clues.title: Muddy coat thread
clues.content: A corridor fiber was caught below the archive desk.
clues.inventoryDescription: A transferable fiber from a public corridor.
clues.narrativeMeaning: It suggests traffic but not an opened packet.

clues.title: The archive was resealed
clues.content: Someone opened the packet after closing time and applied fresh blue wax to imitate the original seal.
clues.inventoryDescription: Shared truth: the archive packet was opened and resealed.
clues.narrativeMeaning: The contradiction converts two private details into a shared conclusion.

dialogues.question: Walk me through the archive closing.
dialogues.answer: I left at 21:00. The seal remained intact, I carried no bag, and I never returned after the guard began his rounds.

testimonyFragments.text: I left at 21:00. The seal remained intact, and I never returned.
I carried no bag when I left the archive.
The guard began his rounds immediately after closing.

evidenceChallenges.prompt: Which physical trace directly contradicts the selected testimony?
evidenceChallenges.successResponse: The overlapping wax layers prove the packet was opened and resealed after the original seal was broken.
evidenceChallenges.failureResponse: That pair does not establish a direct contradiction. Recheck what the trace can actually prove.

deductions.prompt: What does the cracked testimony establish about the archive packet?

options.label: The packet was opened after closing and resealed with fresh wax.
The tram ticket proves the original seal was never disturbed.

deductions.successResponse: The physical trace and the cracked testimony now form one coherent conclusion.
deductions.failureResponse: That conclusion does not account for the overlapping wax layers.

requiredTeamworkChains.description: The Investigator supplies the wax trace, the Interrogator cracks the statement, and both establish the resealing method.

finalLogic.motive: To alter a protected archive record.
finalLogic.method: Open the packet and imitate the original seal with fresh wax.

methodOptions.label: Open the packet and imitate the seal with fresh wax
Replace the packet using a muddy coat thread

finalLogic.winEnding: The paired contradiction proves the packet was resealed.
finalLogic.failEnding: The archive remains sealed behind an untested statement.
